recent_dailies.daily_action: 把 [2610.02200](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200v1) VISTA 列为即时试点方向，写 'vista long-horizon visual memory' checklist 草稿；把 [2610.02199](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02199v1) TACO 同步列为即时路线资产，写 'taco ternary-optimizer-state' checklist 草稿；为 [2610.02206](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206v1) KaliBench 'strict-syntax tool-use benchmark'、[2610.02204](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02204v1) RPG 'embodied self-improvement without weight update'、[2610.02203](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203v1) NEPA 'next-embedding diffusion condition' 维持分类趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期；为 [2610.02202](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202v1) ScholarCatalyst 'inspiration benchmark'、2610.02201 SILSA 'sliding-window 3D latent'、2610.02198 FERPO 'forward entropy RL'、2610.02195 Schrödinger bridges 'Feynman-Kac tilt'、2610.02207 GALA 'Gaussian avatar linear-blend' 维持长尾卡片；忽略无（今日 10 篇全部进入 value routing）。⚠️ 持续观察所有 10 篇是否开源 code / benchmark / project page；尤其关注 VISTA 是否 plug-in 到 production multimodal model 而不破坏 native capability。
recent_dailies.max_uncertainty: VISTA（[2610.02200](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200v1)）active retrieval protocol、lossless visual memory 实现细节（raw frame store vs compressed vs hierarchical）、跨 multimodal model 兼容（GPT-4V / Gemini / Qwen-VL 等）、与现有 agent harness 集成、跨 interactive environment 评测是否公开；TACO（[2610.02199](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02199v1)）ternary quantization scheme 形式化、column-wise one-sparse 实现、跨 AdamW / Muon baseline、跨 LLM 规模验证是否公开；KaliBench（[2610.02206](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206v1)）CLI 覆盖范围、runtime-free verifiable reward 形式化、跨 LLM baseline 是否公开；RPG（[2610.02204](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02204v1)）practice task 构造协议、privileged state 设计、sim-to-real transfer 细节是否公开；NEPA（[2610.02203](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203v1)）next-embedding prediction 架构、跨 diffusion backbone 验证、inference cost 对照是否公开；ScholarCatalyst（[2610.02202](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202v1)）author annotation 协议、IR system baseline、与现有 citation graph benchmark 差异是否公开；SILSA（[2610.02201](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02201v1)）sliding-window slice 协议、topology consistency metric、与现有 voxel latent baseline 对照是否公开；FERPO（[2610.02198](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198v1)）forward entropy 形式化、on-policy 收敛保证、actor-only baseline 对照是否公开；Schrödinger bridges（[2610.02195](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02195v1)）Feynman-Kac tilt 形式化、alternation 算法、跨 graph size 验证是否公开；GALA（[2610.02207](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02207v1)）blendshape 数量、coefficient predictor 协议、与现有 real-time avatar baseline 对照是否公开。所有 10 篇论文均未在摘要里显式披露 code / benchmark / project URL（仅 PDF / arXiv），按规则统一标'暂无'，证据不足项明确写入每条 reason；链接或证据缺失时明确写 '待核验/暂无'，不补写不存在的事实。
recent_dailies.one_line_judgement: 据摘要（arXiv [2610.02200](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200v1)），VISTA 把'visual harness'作为 first-class 概念 ——给 general-purpose multimodal model 配备 long-horizon vision，让它直接通过 visual observation 感知 environment，并用 lossless visual memory 保留 past observations 的原始形态（preserves past observations in their original form），同时允许模型主动 retrieve 过去 observation。这是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × context-engineering 的 'long-horizon visual memory harness' 即时价值资产 ——把'视觉感知'从 'static prompt' 拉到 'first-class memory asset + active retrieval'；与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent 主线在 'visual memory as first-class asset' 层面同源；与 aiutil 长期关注的 context-engineering × memory 主线在 'long-horizon lossless memory' 层面同源（视觉分支）。

top_papers.abstract: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. top_papers.abstract: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. top_papers.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
top_papers.abstract: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units.
